name: A/C compressor (K4M)
summary: Remove and replace the K4M-compatible compressor, preserve the refrigerant circuit, and recharge it with a service station. The cited procedure explicitly groups K4M with K4J and K9K; use the K4M-specific torque set, not the separate F4R/F9Q set.
safety: Refrigerant must be recovered with an approved A/C service station; do not vent it.
Disconnect the battery negative terminal before electrical or mechanical work.
Replace the accessory belt if it has been removed.

removal.text: Recover refrigerant with a service station, disconnect the battery negative terminal, and remove the under-engine cover, right-front wheel, wheel-arch liner, and front bumper.
Remove the reinforcement plate and accessory belt, then cap the opened compressor lines to keep contamination out.
Disconnect the compressor electrical plug, remove its mounting bolts, and lift the unit out.

installation.text: Fit new line seals and lubricate them with the prescribed A/C oil; reconnect the lines and electrical plug.
Refit the compressor and reinforcement plate to the K4M torque specifications, and replace the removed accessory belt.
Recharge the refrigerant circuit using the approved station; do not add oil solely because the compressor was replaced.

checks: Check for refrigerant leakage and confirm cold-air operation with the cabin blower running.
If cooling is absent, use proper leak-detection and diagnostic procedures.

faults.causes: Refrigerant leak, compressor/electrical fault, or another A/C system fault; diagnose rather than adding an assumed refrigerant or oil quantity.

name: A/C condenser
summary: Replace the condenser after refrigerant recovery and front-end access. The fetched procedure gives an oil compensation amount but its removal sequence contains a separate F9Q/K9K branch, so its K4M torque applicability is not assumed here.
safety: Recover refrigerant with an approved service station; never release it to atmosphere.
Disconnect the battery negative terminal before dismantling.
Cap open refrigerant ports promptly.

Run the cabin blower at high speed and confirm that the A/C cools.

removal.text: Recover refrigerant, disconnect the battery, cap the A/C lines, and clamp the heater hoses at the bulkhead.

Remove the HVAC assembly and transfer the specified reusable components to the replacement case.

Restore the battery and perform required learning procedures; release the airbag ECU lock with the diagnostic tool after assembly.

checks: Check refrigerant and coolant circuits for leaks.
Confirm condensate drains freely and verify HVAC operation.

torques.notes: The cited page refers removal to the body repair procedure and gives no torque.

specs.label: Rear window mechanism
specs.value: Manual or impulse electric regulator, depending on equipment

sources.title: Renault Mégane II workshop manual — Moteur de lève-vitre arrière
sources.locator: Deux types de lève-vitres à l’arrière ... manuel; électrique impulsionnel

removal.text: Remove the rear-door trim and support the glass, following the body repair procedure for the fitted regulator type.
Disconnect the electric motor and remove the regulator assembly as a complete unit; the motor is not separately replaceable.

installation.text: Install the complete regulator assembly and reconnect the motor where fitted.
Initialize impulse-type electric motors before testing the anti-pinch and one-touch functions.

checks: Confirm smooth glass travel and verify the expected manual/electric operation for the vehicle.

name: Tailgate lock and central-locking actuator
summary: The tailgate lock can be released manually if electrical operation fails. Remove it through the tailgate trim after disconnecting the battery and electrical harness.
safety: Disconnect the battery before unplugging the lock wiring.
Avoid forcing the tailgate trim or damaging its clips.

sources.title: Tailgate lock assembly
sources.locator: Déposer les deux vis de fixation de la serrure de hayon

torques.notes: The source gives no tightening torque.

specs.label: Manual release
specs.value: The lock may be opened manually during an electrical failure

sources.title: Renault Mégane II workshop manual — Serrure de hayon
sources.locator: Il est possible lors d’une défaillance électrique, d’ouvrir le hayon manuellement.

removal.text: If electrical opening has failed, release the tailgate lock manually at its latch before removing the trim.
Disconnect the battery, remove the tailgate interior trim, remove the lock fasteners, release the lower clip, and disconnect the harness.

installation.text: Reconnect the harness, seat and fasten the lock, then reinstall the tailgate trim.
Restore battery power and complete any required learning procedures.

checks: Test tailgate release using both central locking and the manual release method.

name: Interior dome light
summary: Remove the dome-light lens and release the retaining tabs to lower the lamp. The lamp configuration varies with trim and may include central lighting, one or two reading spots, or dimming.
safety: Use a non-marring trim tool to avoid scratching the lens or headliner.
Avoid shorting the lamp terminals when handling the connector.

sources.title: Interior dome-light assembly
sources.locator: Déclipper le cache translucide avec l’outil Car.1597

torques.notes: The cited removal procedure uses clips and provides no torque.

specs.label: Dome-light functions
specs.value: Central lamp switch; may include one or two reading spots and dimming, depending on trim

sources.title: Renault Mégane II workshop manual — Plafonnier : Généralités
sources.locator: Selon l’emplacement du plafonnier et l’équipement du véhicule

removal.text: Release the translucent lens from the specified side using a non-marring tool.
Pull the retaining tabs and rotate the lamp enough to access its connector.

installation.text: Reconnect the lamp and seat the retaining tabs; refit the translucent lens without forcing its edges.

checks: Test the central lamp and reading-light switches available on the fitted unit.

name: Roof radio / navigation aerial
summary: The aerial is mounted on the roof beneath the headliner. GPS aerial versions integrate the aerial, amplifier, and telephone aerial; equipment level determines the fitted aerial type.
safety: Support the headliner locally to prevent creasing or tearing.
Protect the roof paint and electrical connectors while removing the aerial.

sources.title: Roof aerial assembly
sources.locator: L’antenne est placée sur le pavillon

torques.notes: No torque is stated on the fetched procedure.

specs.label: Integrated functions
specs.value: GPS version integrates the aerial, amplifier, and dual-band telephone aerial

sources.title: Renault Mégane II workshop manual — Antenne
sources.locator: L’antenne GPS intègre l’antenne, l’amplificateur et l’antenne téléphone (bi-bande).

removal.text: Lower the headliner locally, remove the aerial retaining nut, and disconnect the aerial connectors.

installation.text: Reconnect the aerial connectors, seat the aerial on the roof, and secure it with its nut.
Refit the headliner without pinching wiring or deforming the trim.

checks: Check radio reception and navigation/telephone aerial functions fitted to the vehicle.

name: Radio head unit
summary: Remove the radio through the center fascia using the extraction tool appropriate to the fitted radio/navigation system. Audio and navigation equipment varies by trim.
safety: Disconnect the battery negative terminal before removing electrical connectors.
Use the matching radio extraction tool to prevent damage to the dashboard or unit.
tools: Radio extraction tool matched to equipment

sources.title: Radio or navigation unit
sources.locator: Déposer la radio à l’aide de l’outil (Ms. 1373) (si le véhicule en est équipé)

torques.notes: The source procedure uses an extraction tool and does not specify torque.

specs.label: Audio/navigation system
specs.value: Fitted system may include radio, navigation, or CD changer; the control-panel procedure identifies optional equipment

sources.title: Renault Mégane II workshop manual — Tableau de commande
sources.locator: radio ... changeur de disques compacts ... Carminat ... si le véhicule en est équipé

removal.text: Disconnect the battery, remove the center fascia as required, and extract the radio/navigation unit using its correct release tool.
Disconnect the unit harness connectors without pulling on the wiring.

installation.text: Reconnect the radio connectors and fit the unit into its opening; reinstall the fascia and other center equipment.
Restore battery power and enter any required security code using the vehicle-specific procedure.

checks: Check power, sound output, antenna reception, and any fitted navigation or changer functions.
